title: Ninja Nutri-Blender Pro with Auto-iQ | For Smoothies, Shakes, Frozen Drinks, Salsa, Dips | (2) 24-oz. To-Go Cups & Spout Lids | 1100-Peak-Watt | Silver | BN401

reviews.title: Perfect smoothies, solid build .. get it if you can
reviews.body: Big picture, I really like this Ninja blender. I have been using it for about two months now, making smoothies 3–4 times a week, and it has been very efficient.  It pulverizes ingredients extremely well, and cleanup is quick and easy. The two preset Auto-iQ programs for one-touch processing with automatic start and stop are brilliant  ... I love this feature. You can push a button, step away, and come back to a perfect smoothie every time. The unit feels solid and well made, with quality materials that inspire confidence in its durability. It replaced a very old smoothie blender, and this one has honestly taken my smoothies to a whole new level. The only downside is that it’s fairly loud and a bit bulky, but everything else is just perfect ... still deserves the 5 star rating !Read moreRead less

reviews.title: Awesome Blender
reviews.body: Awesome blender/juicer. This replaced my old magic bullet. The blade is super sharp and does the job.I use it to make smoothies each morning and so far, it worked better than what I expected! This thing is very powerful and will grind thru the ice with no problem.  This thing is a beast! I also like that you can just press a button and walk away, the machine will blend automatically instead of having to hold the top down until you are done.It also has feet to keep it in place, which is a nice feature since it is so powerful, it can move if it is not stuck down with the suction cup feet.I love it and think it was a worthwhile investment and would highly recommend it.Read moreRead less

reviews.title: Truly Awesome Product!
reviews.body: I have had this now for around two weeks and have used it each day since and I am so impressed.  This thing makes perfect shakes with ease regardless if it is just a milkshake, or breakfast shake loaded with fresh fruit and ice.  The to go cup makes it easy to make and go, and it cleans up so easily.  This is far better than the piece of junk I had before this and is well worth the extra cost.Read moreRead less

reviews.title: Highly Recommended Blender for Shakes
reviews.body: This blender does the job well for my preparation of iced protein drinks.  The timer default is 60 seconds after which the unit stops automatically.  The fit of the blade mechanism on the mixing cup is secure with no leaks.  Build quality is very good with metal exterior.  The blades are very sharp.  The unit does not overheat with normal use.  This small unit does the same job as our large Ninja blender which shares the same blade mechanism.  The build quality is very good.  The unit sticks to the counter using suction cups.  Great value for the money.Read moreRead less

reviews.author: Louis A Sousa

reviews.title: Powerful Blender for Daily Use — Just Be Ready for the Noise
reviews.body: I use this every day to make a breakfast shake after workouts, and it’s been great. It holds a good amount of liquid and blends very well, even with tougher ingredients. I also prefer the newer lids compared to older Ninja models I’ve had—they’re a nice improvement.There are multiple settings depending on what you’re making, which adds flexibility, and after a year of use it’s still holding up really well.The biggest downside is noise—it’s very loud and will likely wake up the house if others are still sleeping. I also wish it came with more than just two cups.👍 Pros:Powerful blending performanceGreat for daily use (smoothies/shakes)Improved lid design vs older modelsMultiple settings for different drinks👎 Cons:Very loudOnly comes with 2 cups🎯 Final Verdict:If you want a powerful, reliable personal blender for daily use, this is a great choice—just be prepared for the noise.Read moreRead less
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on March 27, 2026
reviews.author: Nick Johnson

reviews.title: Great blender! Works like you need it to!
reviews.body: Full disclosure, I'm writing this review after only using this blender once! I started a habit of making a smoothie every morning, close to a year ago now. For the past few months, my Nutri-Bullet 900 series just kept getting clogged in the blending process, I'd have to take it off the machine and shake it up, bang it on the counter and put it back on to try to blend. Usually three or four times in a row. Enough was enough, I did some research, read reviews, and this blender is everything! My smoothies even taste different, as it's obvious they're FULLY blended. I went back-and-forth between the push down type and the auto blender, and I'm really happy I settled on the auto type. It couldn't be easier, and works like you need it to work. Plus it's easier to clean than my Nutri-Bullet. Really happy with this purchase!Read moreRead less
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on May 11, 2026
reviews.author: G. Rankin

reviews.title: Ninja strikes again!
reviews.body: We love this version of the Nutri Pro. This is our third one. We blend about 500 smoothies a year and we get a couple years out of a unit. Sturdy and stable when used. Not the quietest when running but it works so well I've grown to enjoy the noise knowing its blending up another scrumptious smoothie. The 1000 watt motor reduces ice, pomegranate seeds, carrots, strawberries-anything-frozen or fresh! I know Ninja has a newer model with a handle on the cup and a more powerful motor with lots of stylish colors. Maybe next time I will upgrade.Read moreRead less
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on April 21, 2026
reviews.author: r svet

reviews.title: Hands Free!!
reviews.body: Rec'd in a timely matter and packaged well.  This Ninja is nice and makes the perfect smoothies.  I used to have The Bullet, but this doesn't compare to it at all.  This has suction cups at the bottom, very strong and stays in place really well.  No longer need to hang on while it is chopping.  Hands free!!  It also gives you three different options to choose from for what you are making.  I find this to be a great blender and of great value.  I would definitely recommend this product.Read moreRead less

features: POWERFUL BLENDING PERFORMANCE: 1100-peak-watt motor powers through the toughest ingredients and pulverizes ice to snow in seconds for creamy frozen drinks, smoothies, sauces, and more
AUTO-IQ ONE-TOUCH PRESETS: 2 Auto-iQ preset programs combine unique timed pulsing, blending, and pausing patterns for one-touch smoothies and crushed ice without guesswork
NUTRIENT EXTRACTION: Pro Extractor Blades Assembly unlocks hidden nutrition by breaking down whole fruits and veggies, including portions usually discarded, for vitamin- and nutrient-rich drinks
ON-THE-GO CONVENIENCE: Blend directly in the 24-oz. single-serve cup, attach the spout lid, and take your creations to work, the gym, or wherever the day leads
COMPACT COUNTERTOP FIT: This small blender fits on any countertop with intuitive, easy-to-use controls so you can attach the cup and start blending within seconds
RECIPE INSPIRATION INCLUDED: 20-recipe inspiration guide gets you started with easy-to-prepare smoothies, sauces, dips, and more for everyday meal prep
EASY CLEANUP: All parts are BPA-free and dishwasher safe, with a 2.6-ft cord length for flexible placement on your kitchen countertop
WHAT'S INCLUDED: 1100-Peak-Watt Motor Base, Pro Extractor Blades Assembly, (2) 24-oz. To-Go Cups, (2) Spout Lids, and 20-Recipe Inspiration Guide
